content.short: Everclear is a cross-chain clearing and settlement protocol for intents, bridges, and solver networks.
content.description: Everclear is a clearing layer designed to reduce cross-chain liquidity fragmentation for bridges, intent protocols, solver networks, and applications. Instead of forcing solvers to rebalance funds manually after every fill, Everclear nets opposing flows and settles obligations through a hub-and-spoke architecture. The protocol supports programmable settlement, permissionless chain expansion, and intent-based flows that can lower rebalancing costs for market participants. On Mantle, Everclear provides infrastructure that can help applications access more efficient cross-chain settlement and liquidity routing.
content.meta: Everclear provides cross-chain clearing and settlement infrastructure for intent-based applications on Mantle.
